regions.merged_text: Patrick Hardiman of 205 E. 114 St. Enrolled crippled mother Mary H. Jan. 14th. Feb. 2nd reports - On Jan. 20th No pain as certificate is laid on ice-box - now goes to holy Mass - before enrollment - was pleading for Fr. Sol. to visit her. Now goes shoping as 20 years ago. She cried with Joy at recovery lives at 245 E. 94 St. N. Y. City
